#| Block comment |#
(defpackage :demo
  (:use :common-lisp)
  (:export #:greet))
(in-package :demo)

(defparameter *greeting* "Hello")

(defun greet (name &key (times 1))
  "Greets NAME TIMES times."
  (let ((text (format nil "~a, ~a!~%" *greeting* name)))
    (loop repeat times collect text)))

(defmacro unless* (test &body body)
  `(if ,test nil (progn ,@body)))

(when (and t (not nil))
  (print (greet "world" :times 2))
  (mapcar #'1+ '(1 2 3))
  (setf (gethash 'key (make-hash-table)) #\a))
